question:
In the given figure, 1 || m and t is a transversal. If ∠1 and ∠2 are in the ratio 4 : 11, the measures of the angles ∠8 and ∠7, respectively, are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/376bdc7436a6b16d69de4a5083404690b26382ce9ed01aca23960a7f2d350c43.png]
solution:
Given:-

l II m

 

t is the transversal line

 

∠1 : ∠2 = 4 : 11

 

Concept Used:-

 

Parallel lines properties.

 

Linear pair makes 180° angle.

 

Exterior angle on opposite side of transversal lines are equal.

 

Calculation:-

 

Let the value of ∠1 = 4x°

 

The value of ∠2 = 11 x°

 

⇒ ∠1 + ∠2 = 180° [Linear Pair]

 

⇒ 4x° + 11x° = 180°

 

⇒ 15x° = 180°

 

⇒ x = 12°

 

⇒ ∠1 = 4x° 

 

⇒ 48°

 

⇒ ∠2 = 11x°

 

⇒ 132°

 

⇒ ∠1 = ∠7 [Opposite exterior angles]

 

⇒ ∠7 = 48°

 

⇒ ∠2 = ∠8 [Opposite exterior angles]

 

⇒ ∠8 = 132°

∴ The measures of angles ∠7 and ∠8, respectively are 48° and 132°.
